description: Master-output meter readings every surface must reproduce on one input. Each case builds a mixer from `scene` at `sampleRate` with blocks of `blockSize` frames, turns the master meter on with loudness off and `truePeakOversample`, and processes `blocks` blocks on the one strip. Sample n of the strip's left input is amplitude*sin(2*pi*frequencyHz*n/sampleRate + phaseRad), computed in double and rounded to float; the right input is that double value times rightGain, rounded to float. `expected` is the meter read after the last block, `expectedAfterFlush` after flushing the meters. Readings are in dBFS except correlation; compare within `toleranceDb` (dB fields) and `toleranceCorrelation`.
